name: orakulware-knowledge-api
postCreateCommand: mkdir -p /root/.gnupg && chmod 700 /root/.gnupg && cp -r /run/host-gnupg/. /root/.gnupg/ && find /root/.gnupg -name 'S.*' -delete && find /root/.gnupg -name '*.lock' -delete && printf 'pinentry-program /usr/bin/pinentry\n' > /root/.gnupg/gpg-agent.conf && chmod 700 /root/.gnupg /root/.gnupg/private-keys-v1.d && find /root/.gnupg -type f -exec chmod 600 {} \; && echo 'export GPG_TTY=$(tty)' >> ~/.zshrc && git config --global commit.gpgsign true && git config --global user.signingkey "$GPG_SIGNING_KEY" && git config --global user.name "$GIT_USER_NAME" && git config --global user.email "$GIT_USER_EMAIL"
